spans.s: --complete extermination be- tween one kalpa and the next one, while the sandhis or con- nections between the manvantaras or yugas is not broken (avyucchinna sandhi). वा. 7. 8-9. [page३-351+ २८]
--a son of शन्खण and father of विश्व- saha. Br. III. ६३. २०६.
(I)--a son of दोषा and पुष्पार्ण; wife पुष्क- रिणी and son Sarvatejas. भा. IV. १३. १४.
(II)--a son of विभावसु, and a Vasu. भा.
--one of the ten branches of the Rohita clan of devas. वा. १००. ९१.
